findings.title: Stored XSS: comment body assigned to innerHTML
findings.evidence: Replaced 'el.textContent = comment.body;' with 'el.innerHTML = comment.body;', so any HTML/script payload in a comment body is parsed and executed when renderComment runs.
findings.recommendation: Revert to textContent for the comment body; if rich formatting is required, sanitize through a vetted allow-list sanitizer (e.g. DOMPurify) before assignment and add a test that renders a comment body containing a script/img-onerror payload and asserts no element/attribute is created.
